text.en: Believing a star's luminosity keeps increasing all the way from the centre to the surface, since energy is constantly being added — luminosity only increases with radius within the actively fusing core; outside the fusing region, no more energy is being added, so luminosity stays constant out to the surface.
text.et: Arvamus, et tähe heledus kasvab pidevalt kogu tee keskpunktist pinnani, kuna energiat pidevalt lisatakse — heledus kasvab raadiusega ainult aktiivselt sulatava tuuma piires; väljaspool sulatavat piirkonda enam energiat ei lisata, nii et heledus jääb pinnani konstantseks.
